title: Pre-market Technical Blog - 03 Aug 2026
headline: Nifty pre-market bias is positive, with expected opening flat to mildly positive.

gift_nifty.note: Add GIFT_NIFTY_LEVEL or GIFT_NIFTY_SYMBOL in .env for a live pre-open gap estimate.

pattern_notes: Nifty is above 20 DMA, above 50 DMA, and below 200 DMA.
Last 5-session return is 3.24%, while last 20-session return is 1.41%.
CPR width is 0.349%; a narrow CPR can support trend expansion, while a wide CPR can invite range-bound action.
Immediate bullish confirmation improves above TC 24731.11 and R1 24860.68; weakness increases below BC 24644.73 and S1 24601.53.

blog_sections.heading: Market Opening View
blog_sections.body: Based on the available GIFT Nifty input, global-market tone and Nifty trend structure, the market can open flat to mildly positive. Treat the first 15-30 minutes as confirmation because large gaps can reverse if price fails near CPR or previous-day extremes.

blog_sections.heading: Technical View For The Day
blog_sections.body: Above CPR top 24731.11, buyers have better control and the first upside zones are 24860.68 and 24947.07. Below CPR bottom 24644.73, sellers gain control and downside zones are 24601.53 and 24428.77. A sustained move around pivot 24687.92 can mean a range day.

blog_sections.heading: What Can Make The Market Go Up
blog_sections.body: Positive global cues, GIFT Nifty premium, Nifty holding above CPR, and leadership from Stage 2/RRG leading industries can support upside follow-through.

blog_sections.heading: What Can Make The Market Go Down
blog_sections.body: Weak Asian markets, rising USD/INR or crude pressure, GIFT Nifty discount, and Nifty failing below CPR/S1 can increase downside risk.

disclaimer: Educational market note only; not investment advice. Confirm price action after market open and manage risk.
